title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
statement:
You are given an integer array nums sorted in ascending order that has been rotated at some unknown pivot. The array may contain duplicates. Find the index of a given target value in the array. If the target is not found, return -1.

You must solve this with O(log n) time complexity.
constraints: nums is guaranteed to be rotated at some pivot

visibleExamples.explanation: Target 0 is found at index 4 in the rotated array.
Target 3 is not present in the array.
Single element array containing the target.
